blocks.tamil_translation: becomes obligatory for him.” Hazrat Abu Sa'id Khudri (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said this. These words greatly delighted Hazrat Abu Sa'id (RA). He requested, “O Rasulullah, please say it again,” and the Prophet ﷺ said it again. “There is also another deed by which a servant is raised a hundred levels in Jannah. The distance between every two of the hundred levels is equal to the distance between the heavens and the earth.” “O Rasulullah, what is that?” I asked. “That is striving in the path of Allah Ta'ala, striving in the path of Allah Ta'ala,” the Prophet ﷺ said. Hazrat Abu Sa'id Khudri (RA) narrates this.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ عَمْرٍو ﵄ قَالَ: مَاتَ رَجُلٌ بِالْمَدِينَةِ مِمَّنْ وُلِدَ بِهَا فَصَلَّي عَلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ ثُمَّ قَالَ: يَا لَيْتَهُ مَاتَ بِغَيْرِ مَوْلِدِهِ قَالُوا: وَلِمَ ذَاكَ يَا رَسُولَ اللهِ؟ قَالَ: إِنَّ الرَّجُلَ إِذَا مَاتَ بِغَيْرِ مَوْلِدِهِ قِيسَ لَهُ مِنْ مَوْلِدِهِ إِلَي مُنْقَطَعِ أَثَرِهِ فِي الْجَنَّةِ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه النسائي، باب الموت بغير مولده، رقم:١٨٣٣
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abdullah ibn Amr (RA) says, “A man who was born in Madinah died in Madinah itself. The Prophet ﷺ led the Janazah Salah for him and then said, “Alas! It would have been good if this man had died in a place other than where he was born!” The Sahabah (RA) asked, “O Rasulullah, why did you say so?” Rasulullah ﷺ replied, “When a man leaves the place where he was born and dies somewhere else, the distance from the place of his birth to the place of his death is measured, and a space of that size is given to him in Jannah.”
